definition_kind.description: Only metrics with this query node kind.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

search.description: Words to match against the metric name, display name, description, and definition. Results come best match first. A metric matches when it contains any word, compared by stem. A quoted phrase must match all its words, and common words such as 'what' or 'our' are ignored. Partial words, synonyms, and acronyms do not match: 'rev' does not find 'revenue', and 'mrr' does not find 'monthly recurring revenue'.

status.description: Only metrics with this review status.
